decisions.reason: As a multi-item line close to the core range that kept its own page in both 2023 and 2024, it likely meets aspiration levels and is worth retaining in a small firm with limited but sufficient slack for proven products.

Because it remained on the website across both years and fits the firm's established facial-care competence, management would likely see its results as acceptable even if its lower prominence than A suggests somewhat less certainty.

As a 2024 launch in the core business it would usually be given more time, but as a small firm that already showed willingness to drop weak newcomers quickly, management would keep it only while monitoring whether its early performance reaches aspiration levels.
